With a workforce of ~20,000 professionals serving 350+clients across 30+ markets, Straive combines technical scale with deep domain expertise. The company continues to earn recognition from leading industry analysts and was recently named a Leader in AIM’s 2026 Generative AI and Data Engineering PeMa Quadrants. Backed by EQT — a purpose-driven global investment organization which was ranked among the world’s leading private equity firms by PEI in 2025 — Straive is positioned as a high-value alternative to traditional IT services providers, combining domain-led intelligence with AI execution at scale.

About the Role
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our growing engineering team. The ideal candidate will have 5–8 years of professional experience, a strong background in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and configuration management, and a passion for automating processes and improving system reliability. This role is pivotal in ensuring the stability, scalability, and performance of our core products.

Key Responsibilities
●	CI/CD Pipeline Management: Design, implement, and maintain robust, automated continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using tools like Team Foundation Server, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions.
●	Infrastructure Management (IaC): Manage and provision cloud infrastructure (AWS (must have) /Azure/GCP (optional)) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, primarily Terraform or CloudFormation/ARM Templates.
●	Webservers: IIS, App pools, Apache, Nginx
●	Experience of the build and deployment process of  Microsoft .Net based web applications using MSBuild along with deployment scripts creation using Powershell on AWS servers and services.
●	Experience of the build and deployment process of Angular + Node and .Net core based web applications and containers using docker along with deployment scripts creation using shell + powershell  scripting  
●	Containerization & Orchestration: Deploy, scale, and manage containerized applications using Beanstalk, ECS, Docker and Kubernetes.
●	Monitoring and Alerting: Implement and manage comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog/NewRelic, ELK stack) to ensure high availability and proactive issue detection.
●	Automation & Scripting: Write and maintain scripts (e.g., Powershell, Python, Bash, or Groovy) to automate repetitive tasks, system maintenance, and deployment processes.
●	Security & Compliance: Implement security best practices within the infrastructure and pipelines (e.g., vulnerability scanning, secret management).
●	Collaboration: Work closely with software development and QA teams to troubleshoot environment issues, define release strategies, and implement necessary infrastructure changes.
●	System Reliability: Participate in on-call rotations and incident response, perform root cause analysis, and continuously drive improvements for system reliability and performance.
●	Collaboration: Work closely with software development and QA teams, and interact directly with international stakeholders and customers to troubleshoot environment issues, define release strategies, and implement necessary infrastructure changes.
●	Hands-on experience using Jira and Confluence within agile environments, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams through daily standups, sprint ceremonies, and regular team syncs to ensure transparent communication and efficient delivery.
●	Hands-on experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines, enabling continuous validation of application quality. Skilled in orchestrating unit, integration, and end-to-end tests within build workflows to ensure reliable deployments, faster feedback loops, and consistent delivery across environment

Required Qualifications & Skills (5–8 Years Experience)
●	Proven experience (5–8 years) as a Sr. DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), or similar role.
●	Cloud Expertise: Expert-level proficiency with at least one major public cloud provider (AWS,).
●	Containerization: Deep working knowledge of Docker and experience with an orchestration platform like Kubernetes (K8s) & Amazon ECS.
●	IaC: Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Cloudformation.
●	CI/CD Tools: Extensive experience configuring and managing CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
●	Operating Systems: Solid understanding of Linux/Unix administration and networking concepts.
●	Scripting: Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Powershell, Python, Bash).
●	Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of troubleshooting complex distributed systems.
●	Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially for documenting processes and communicating with cross-functional teams & customers

Good to Have (Certifications & Extras)

●	Zero downtime deployment, blue-green, rolling update concepts 
●	AI toolsets & automation workflow tools.

We are looking for an experienced SRE / DevOps Engineer with hands-on experience in AWS cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, on-premises infrastructure, and Java-based microservices. Manage and support AWS cloud infrastructure and on-premises environments.

Administer and troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters, containers, and application deployments.

Support Java-based microservices running in production environments.

Monitor application and infrastructure health, availability, performance, and resource utilization.

Troubleshoot production incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement preventive measures.

Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions.

Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and operational tasks.

Support CI/CD pipelines and application release deployments.

Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and application teams to improve system reliability and operational efficiency.

Participate in on-call support and incident management activities as required.

Experience managing AWS cloud infrastructure and services.

Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker in production environments.

Experience supporting on-premises infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments.

Experience troubleshooting and supporting Java-based microservices.

Knowledge of Linux system administration, networking, and infrastructure troubleshooting.

Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK, or CloudWatch.

Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.

Knowledge of infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform or Ansible.

Strong troubleshooting, incident management, and root cause analysis skills.

Good to Have
Experience with high-availability and distributed systems.

Knowledge of service-level indicators (SLIs), service-level objectives (SLOs), and service-level agreements (SLAs).

Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or Shell.

Experience managing production workloads across cloud and on-premises environments.
